the C incorporation has a positive effect on the quality of the grown oxides.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the C incorporation into the strained SiGe layers is beneficial for reducing the charge trapping and the valence band offsets of the ternary SiGeC alloys.

C incorporation into the Si1-xGey heterolayer reduces the valence band discontinuity, improves the charge trapping properties of the gate oxide and also reduces the effective hole concentration of the heterostructure.
the C doping in the strained Si1-x-yGexeC1-y layers can be used to improve the charge trapping and breakdown properties of the gate oxide.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of C in Si1-x-yGexeC1-x alloys can improve the charge trapping properties of the grown oxides.
, the C incorporation in Si1-x-yGexeCy ternary alloys can significantly improve the charge trapping characteristics of the grown oxide.
, the C incorporation in the Si1-x-yGexeCy heterostructure can be used to improve the charge trapping characteristics in MOS capacitors with ultra-thin gate oxide.
